messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-serving-pool-us-west-1 instance=pool-gpu-13 reason=CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL threshold=5m
alex_dev: acked. I’m on it. seeing ~10% increase in alloc failures in the dashboards. paging into thread for coordination.
pagerduty: alex_dev acknowledged alert. If not resolved within 10m, will escalate to irene_sre.
maya_oncall: +1 watching. can you share the failing model or route? might be KV cache pressure
alex_dev: logs show repeated `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` from worker-13 handling model=rw-oss-7b q=128. stack snippets attached in logs.
sam_ops: is this noisy single-worker or whole pool? I’m checking pool metrics now.
leo_infra: looks like fragmentation. vm_mapped memory for GPU[13] is high and free chunks keep shrinking. Also kvcache eviction metric spiked 00:01 UTC
alex_dev: trying soft-evict <pool=pool-gpu-13> to drain long-lived sessions. command:
```
./admin/drain_pool --pool pool-gpu-13 --grace 30s
```
sam_ops: starting evict; running auto-evict script now. output:
```
[evict] found 12 sessions > 5m
[evict] migrating 9 sessions to fallback pool-gpu-standby
[evict] succeeded: 9 migrated, 3 kept
```
maya_oncall: customers? any 5xx spikes? console shows a temporary routing fallback; error rate on /v1/generate rose to 2.4% for 60s then dropped
irene_sre: good. prepare for potential escalation if evict fails. alex, if evict doesn't free ~2GB in 2m, we should restart the runtime on node-13 and failover traffic.
alex_dev: agreed. monitoring freed memory. current GPU mem free before: 1.1GB, after evict: 2.9GB
pagerduty: auto-escalation canceled (alert acknowledged and mitigation in progress)
sam_ops: I’m kicking a soft-runtime-restart now to clear any driver-side fragmentation — rolling restart to avoid customer impact:
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart ds/redwood-runtime-gpu-13
```
leo_infra: noticed an additional warning in dmesg on node-13: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79` — keep an eye but restart usually clears it
maya_oncall: after restart, error rate back to baseline. monitoring for 10m. good catch on kvcache policy, should we lower prefetch for this pool? :thinking_face:
alex_dev: yes, lowering prefetch for rw-oss-7b on pool-gpu-13 to reduce transient kv churn. patch will go through config service.
irene_sre: thanks team. please add a short post-incident note with timeline and the kvcache tweak so product can review potential perf impact.
alex_dev: will file a follow-up postmortem ticket. marking thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
